title.en: An Act Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds for the Construction, Equipment and Maintenance of a Leprosy Research Laboratory and Training Center.
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds for the Construction, Equipment and Maintenance of a Leprosy Research Laboratory and Training Center.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1953/ra_967_1953.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby authorized to be appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated the sum of three hundred thousand pesos for the construction, equipment and maintenance of an adequate leprosy research laboratory and training center building.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 20, 1953.
